fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: Bara 从奶奶那儿收到 10 个红包，从爷爷那儿收到 4 个，一共几个？

questions.subject: language
questions.q_en: Which English word rhymes with "red" (like a red lantern)?
questions.q_zh: 哪个英文单词和 red（红色）押韵？
questions.explain_en: Red and bed both end with the sound -ed.
questions.explain_zh: red 和 bed 都以 -ed 的音结尾。
questions.qtype_zh: 词义（同义/反义/押韵/词义）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: {name} has 13 paper-cut window flowers and sticks 2 on the window. How many are still in the box?
questions.q_zh: {name} 有 13 张窗花，往窗上贴了 2 张，盒子里还剩几张？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A tanghulu stall sells 6 sticks in the morning and 2 in the afternoon. How many sticks in all?
questions.q_zh: 糖葫芦摊上午卖了 6 串，下午卖了 2 串，一共卖了几串？

questions.subject: spring_festival
questions.q_en: Near the bridge, a gate has two red strips with matching lines, one on each side. What are they called?
questions.q_zh: 桥边一座门的两边各贴一条红纸，上面的句子字字相对。它们叫什么？
questions.explain_en: Matching lines on red paper by the door are spring couplets.
questions.explain_zh: 门两边字字相对的红纸是春联。
questions.qtype_zh: 春联知识（对仗/平仄/横批）

questions.subject: spring_festival
questions.q_en: A row of lanterns on the bridge shows the 12 zodiac animals in order. Which animal comes right after the Tiger?
questions.q_zh: 桥上一排灯笼按顺序画着十二生肖。虎后面紧接着是哪种动物？
questions.explain_en: The order begins Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon.
questions.explain_zh: 顺序开头是鼠、牛、虎、兔、龙。

questions.subject: beijing
questions.q_en: At the end of the ride, Flora stops on the Seventeen-Arch Bridge and counts the arches under it. How many arches does the bridge have?
questions.q_zh: 骑到终点，Flora 停在十七孔桥上，数桥下的桥洞。这座桥有几个桥洞？
questions.explain_en: The bridge is named for its 17 arches.
questions.explain_zh: 这座桥因 17 个桥洞得名。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the end of the ride, 9 kids are on the bridge and 4 more run up to see the lanterns. How many kids are on the bridge now?
questions.q_zh: 骑到终点时，桥上有 9 个小朋友，又跑来 4 个看灯笼，现在桥上有几个小朋友？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 14 lanterns hang on the Seventeen-Arch Bridge. The wind blows out 2 of them. How many lanterns still glow?
questions.q_zh: 十七孔桥上挂着 14 个灯笼，风吹灭了 2 个，还有几个亮着？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On the bridge, 9 red lanterns and 7 gold lanterns are lit. How many more red lanterns than gold ones are there?
questions.q_zh: 桥上亮着 9 个红灯笼和 7 个金灯笼，红灯笼比金灯笼多几个？
questions.qtype_zh: 比较相差（多多少/高多少）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On the bridge, Flora counts 5 strings of 10 lanterns and 9 single lanterns. How many lanterns is that?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在桥上数到 5 串灯笼（每串 10 个）和 9 个单独的灯笼，一共多少个？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Lanterns under the bridge arches are numbered 5, 7, 9 in a pattern. What number is on the next lantern?
questions.q_zh: 桥洞下的灯笼按规律编号：5、7、9，下一个灯笼是几号？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the bridge, Flora opens her red envelope and finds 3 five-yuan notes and 4 one-yuan coins. How many yuan are inside?
questions.q_zh: 在桥上，Flora 打开红包，看到 3 张五元和 4 个一元硬币，里面一共多少元？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora sees 4 hexagon-shaped lantern frames on the bridge. How many sides do they have altogether?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在桥上看见 4 个六边形的灯笼框，它们一共有几条边？
